result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I didn't compile it or run any tests.

The block was formatting `loc180Days` for the LOC figure. It already used `loc90Days` for the percentage, which is why it didn't match. I changed that one argument to `loc90Days` in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`.

I didn't add a test for your 500-LOC / 2,000-LOC example.
